text:
Ava: Heads-up from NordicPay POC call — they need SOC2 Type II attestation (exec summary ok), ISO27001 cert, a signed pen-test letter, and a presigned upload for staging. They want uploads w/in EU region and a 72h window. @Priya @Matt
Diego: Do they want full pen-test report or just attestation? redaction?
Ava: They said attestation + scoped findings summary. No raw creds or vuln scanner output.
Priya: We can provide SOC2 exec summary PDF and ISO cert. For pen-test letter we need a signatory + legal-approved template. I'll ping legal.
Matt: I can be listed as "Ops Lead, Redwood Inference" for signature. Legal will want the exact wording; we typically replace any sensitive sections with [REDACTED].
legal-bot: legal-template-v2.docx uploaded to /internal/legal/templates/pen-test-letter-v2.docx
Ava: Customer asks for S3 presigned URL scoped to /nordicpay/poc-uploads/<org>/evidence.zip, 72h expiry, max size ~1GB. They explicitly said no KMS keys or scanning creds.
ops-bot: Please open ticket with ops: #OPS-5123 (request: presigned PUT, region=eu-west-1, path=/nordicpay/poc-uploads/erik-lind/evidence.zip, expiry=72h, max_size=1GB).
Diego: ETA on presigned URL?
Priya: I'll request presign once legal confirms the redaction level for pen-test. If legal approves now, presign can be done in ~1h.
Matt: Redaction policy we follow: provide executive summary, remediation confirmation, and CVE IDs redacted if customer requests. Full vuln logs only for internal review or with explicit NDA and additional controls.
Ava: Customer wants the pen-test letter to include scope: production + staging, timeframe last 12 months, and remediation statement. Also asked whether we can notarize the letter; they said "nice to have" not mandatory.
Priya: Legal — can we route the template to Matt for signature and optionally notarize?
legal-bot: @Priya routing to legal counsel. Notarization typically not provided; we can add corporate stamp if required. Counsel will review and approve language by EOD.
Ava: I'll confirm whether NordicPay needs notarization or corporate stamp. Erik's email: erik.lind@nordicpay.com (from call).
Diego: Quick pricing note — if customer requests Dedicated/on-prem POC for data residency, that will change pricing. Flag for AE.
Ava: Good catch. I'll open a separate thread for Dedicated pricing.
Matt: Once legal signs, I'll attach signed PDF here and ops will post presigned URL. Please remind customer to upload within 72h.
Ava: Thanks team. Closing when artifacts + signed letter + presign posted here. :white_check_mark:
